# Book stack: three closed books (wine, blue, green covers, cream pages showing on the long side),
# each turned a little. Origin on the ground. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pages --base-color 0.9608 0.9333 0.6902 --no-slot
material new C0 --base-color 0.5608 0.1961 0.3725 --no-slot
material new C1 --base-color 0.3294 0.4745 0.6902 --no-slot
material new C2 --base-color 0.3765 0.6118 0.3098 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Cover0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0.190
scale 2.6 1.9 0.38
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Pages0 --size 1 --location 0.06 0.06 0.190
scale 2.54 1.82 0.266
apply --scale
material assign Pages
select Cover0
active Cover0
material assign C0
select Cover0 Pages0
active Cover0
join
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Cover1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0.550
scale 2.3 1.7 0.34
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Pages1 --size 1 --location 0.06 0.06 0.550
scale 2.24 1.62 0.238
apply --scale
material assign Pages
select Cover1
active Cover1
material assign C1
select Cover1 Pages1
active Cover1
join
set rotation 0 0 9
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Cover2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0.870
scale 2.0 1.5 0.3
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Pages2 --size 1 --location 0.06 0.06 0.870
scale 1.94 1.42 0.210
apply --scale
material assign Pages
select Cover2
active Cover2
material assign C2
select Cover2 Pages2
active Cover2
join
set rotation 0 0 -6
apply --rotation
select Cover0 Cover1 Cover2
active Cover0
join
rename Cover0 Books
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 && pos.z < 0.05"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export books.glb
